_comment: Captured Schemathesis run summary (machine-readable report tail) from a real fast-profile scan of a staging API. Saved so run-stats parsing (dast.adapters.schemathesis_adapter._run_statistics) can be exercised from a fixture with no subprocess and no network. The single trust rule under test: requests_made/request_errors/timeouts are read from Schemathesis's OWN network statistics (requests that actually reached the target), NEVER from the generated-case count. Note that generated_cases (4820) is deliberately far larger than requests_made (4791): a parser that read the case count would over-report reach.
